lines: Love has played 94% of snaps over his last 3 games, but he threw 32.3 passes per game in that stretch, down from 36.8 on the season.
He's scored 22.8 PPR points per game over his last 3 games, compared with 19.6 on the season, with 293.3 passing yards and 2.3 passing TDs per game.
Green Bay has a bye in Wk 11. The coach said the Packers will aim to get the ball out quicker and may use more tempo to protect Love.
